quest.title: Mineral Research: Moonfall Silver
quest.description: There appears to be some kind of event taking place in the plaza of Nasha Town...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2, Moonfall Silver x15, Adventure EXP x150, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2, Moonfall Silver x10

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (Hmm... seems like it's not starting yet.)

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (Wait for a while.)

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The appreciation event finally begins...

talks.objective: Head to the designated location to investigate

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Dorota? What are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Dorota
dialogues.text: You couldn't have come at a better time, Linnea! I was just telling everyone about the wonders of Moonfall Silver.

dialogues.speaker: Dorota
dialogues.text: Oh, Moonfall Silver, Moonfall Silver... is there any gem more perfect in the sublunary sphere?

dialogues.speaker: Dorota
dialogues.text: Look! Its flawless form, its smooth, rounded texture! And that iridescent white paired with unrivaled elemental affinity!

dialogues.speaker: Dorota
dialogues.text: In my eyes, only the moon in the sky can compare to you!

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Umm... yeah. Moonfall Silver is a beautiful ore. I've collected a few samples myself.

dialogues.speaker: Dorota
dialogues.text: See, I knew you'd understand!

dialogues.speaker: Dorota
dialogues.text: But still, no one understands Moonfall Silver better than I do! Even if you're an advisor to the Adventurers' Guild, I'm not giving up first place that easily. Hehe.

dialogues.speaker: Dorota
dialogues.text: Right! And since you're usually the one teaching adventurers, how about I test you for a change?

dialogues.speaker: Dorota
dialogues.text: I have three pieces of Moonfall Silver here. Sadly, two of them have minor flaws. The last one, though, that's my prized treasure. The Moonfall Silver among Moonfall Silvers!

dialogues.speaker: Dorota
dialogues.text: Can you tell which one is the most perfect?

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Let me see...

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: The one on the left...

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (Hmm? What is Lumi doing?)

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: I'll go with this one!

dialogues.speaker: Dorota
dialogues.text: Haha, looks like even you can misjudge sometimes, Linnea. This one actually has a tiny flaw hidden in a very inconspicuous spot.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Okay, you got me. But next time, I'm not going down that easily!

dialogues.speaker: Dorota
dialogues.text: Fine by me. I'm always ready!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Linnea ends up taking part in Dorota's Moonfall Silver Appreciation Event, and had a really lovely time...

dialogues.speaker: Dorota
dialogues.text: Wow, didn't expect everyone to be so enthusiastic. It's a shame moments like this never seem to last... Alright, time to pack up and head back.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Let me help you.

dialogues.speaker: Dorota
dialogues.text: Oh, that'd be nice! Thanks!

dialogues.speaker: Moonfall Silver Appreciation Event
dialogues.text: "If you've ever been captivated by the iridescent glow of Moonfall Silver, join us and become a member of the Moonfall Silver Appreciation Society!"

talks.objective: Reclaim the Moonfall Silver used for exhibition

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (There seems to be something nearby worth examining. <color=#FFCC33FF>Linnea</color>, with her deep knowledge of the local ecology, might find something useful...)

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Whew... we didn't miss any, right?

dialogues.speaker: Dorota
dialogues.text: Hmm... nope, everything's just right!

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: I saw you making those fun patterns on the ground with Moonfall Silver.

dialogues.speaker: Dorota
dialogues.text: Yeah! It took quite a bit of effort, but I think it really helped to spark everyone's love for the Moonfall Silver.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, I heard that there's a folk tale from Natlan...

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: It's about a girl who originally lived among the stars. When she fell to the earth, she left huge drawings on the ground in her effort to return to the sky.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: In the end, her father, the sun up in the heavens, saw her request and brought her back.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Maybe he'd see the patterns you made and become a fan of Moonfall Silver too!

dialogues.speaker: Dorota
dialogues.text: Haha, if that's the case, then I'd be the ultimate Moonfall Silver ambassador!

dialogues.speaker: Dorota
dialogues.text: But compared to that, I'm still more worried about getting noticed by birds from above. You know, crows and all, they really like shiny things too.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: True. And besides crows, we've also got to watch out for Sniffer Moles and Weasel Thieves on the ground.

dialogues.speaker: Dorota
dialogues.text: And Lumi too!

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Haha, right! And Lumi too!

dialogues.speaker: Lumi
dialogues.text: Ya-ho?

dialogues.speaker: Dorota
dialogues.text: Anyway, thanks for helping out earlier. Even though this is just a small portion of my collection... here, take them! Consider it a gift for Lumi.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Hehe, today's a really lucky day, isn't it, Lumi?

dialogues.speaker: Lumi
dialogues.text: Ya-hoho!

dialogues.speaker: Dorota
dialogues.text: If they were crafted into artisanal pieces, wouldn't they be more of a hit...?
